items.html: Know, that the aspect of the Mayin Nukvin of ZA and his Nukva are the souls of the righteous, who are called their sons, in the secret of 'sons are you to the Lord your God.' And the aspect of the MAN of AVI are ZA and his Nukva, their sons. And as we explained, that every night and every night the souls of the lower ones ascend in the secret of 'into Your hand I entrust my spirit,' at the time of lying down, and the upper Nukva of ZA becomes pregnant with them, in the secret of 'they are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness.'
